title: Honey Blood
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After a girl at her school is attacked in what looks like a vampire bite, Hinata Sorazono, a student at a Catholic school who does not believe in vampires, meets her new neighbor Junya Tokinaga, a kimono-wearing author of best-selling vampire romance novels (VIZ blurb via AniList; MangaUpdates). She is drawn to him while suspecting he may be the attacker. A two-volume shoujo supernatural romance built from the author's earlier vampire one-shots.
life_message: It suggests that love means seeing past rumor and fear to who someone really is (to verify).
